TAX (22): 100L has a duplicate table variant in source (12 units, no ACC); TAX 311 code is used for two different courses; ACC 101/ACC 102 have no LO entry within the Taxation section (titles null); TAX 411/421 share a combined 6-unit project title in source.

sourceFlags: All 228 pages were scanned for elective-status courses. Every course in every programme's Global Course Structure table carries Status: C (Core). There are no E-status elective courses in this document. No elective clusters or specialisation pathways exist in this CCMAS — the document acknowledges electives in graduation language ("passed all core courses and electives") but does not define or list any elective courses within the CCMAS itself. This is flagged for manual follow-up: institutions likely define electives locally.
D5 (Discipline Learning Outcomes) — section does not exist in document.

P9b (UTME subject combinations) — NOT FOUND for all 7 programmes. The document specifies O'Level subject requirements at discipline level and repeats them per programme, but never specifies the UTME sitting subject combination for any Computing programme.

P7 (Employability Skills): CS, Data Science, ICT, IS, IT, and SE present these as narrative paragraphs rather than numbered lists. Only Cybersecurity presents Employability Skills as a structured numbered list.

P8 (21st Century Skills): Data Science (items 1/7, 2/13, 5/10, 4/12), ICT (items 1/6, 2/7, 5/11), and Software Engineering (items 5/7) contain apparent duplicate list items in the source document — all extracted verbatim.
ICT P12: SIWES II is listed as ICT 398 in the table header but ICT 399 inline. Manual verification needed.
DTS 304 learning outcomes differ between IS (4 outcomes) and CS/Data Science (7 outcomes) — extracted verbatim per programme as they appear.
IFT 212 learning outcomes differ between SE (8 outcomes, different framing) and CS/IT versions — extracted verbatim per programme.
SE COS 102: listed as 3 units with PH 45 (other programmes: 2 units, PH 0). Extracted verbatim.
SE COS 409: listed as 3 units (other programmes: 2 units). Extracted verbatim.
employability_skills populated from each programme's P8 21st Century Skills numbered list (verbatim), since P7 Employability Skills is a narrative paragraph for all programmes except Cybersecurity.
